text: Inside foreign settlement Cityham at 960x540: Settlement/Market Info panels overlap the Season and Player Info panels on the right; bottom command bar's 'Exit Settlement' button is cut off at the right edge; big world-space labels (town name, 'Bella Evans Industrious (doing nothing)') draw over the chronicle and objective panels. tick ~1900

In Cityham's town square, a green pawn (Charlie Thomas) stands 1.8-3m in front of the player, but G says 'There is no one within reach to give a gift to.' and R says 'There is no one within reach to invite.' and E enters the settlement. Pawns counted as inside a settlement are still drawn on the plaza but can't be reached. Nothing on screen says why, and the command bar shows no pawn button. tick ~4700

Founding a settlement: F says only 'Too close to another settlement.' twice while the nearest settlements were ~200m and ~105m away. The message doesn't give the minimum distance (250m in GameConfig) or which settlement is too close, and there is no map, so I sprinted in four directions for ~1.5 game-minutes while AI nations kept founding new towns ahead of me. tick 10989-13421
Objective 7 'Reach the Village era' progress bar text is clipped on the left: it reads 'bers 4/10 • Buildings 0/2' instead of 'Members 4/10 • Buildings 0/2'. tick ~15700

Objective 6 'Build a market stall (Wood 3/20, Stone 0/5)' completed with +50 coins at tick 13801 when the pawn Bella Jones built a stall in my settlement. I had 3 wood and 0 stone and never pressed B. The chronicle also logged 'Trade came to Farmfield: Bella Jones built a stall.' twice (ticks 13801 and 13853), while the Market panel shows 2 stalls (Ruth Walker, Bella Jones). See after_laws.png

Members of my own nation (Bella Jones, Ruth Walker, Charlie Thompson) stand 1.4-3.6m from me, up to ~10m outside my settlement's well. Over 10 tries, G always said 'There is no one within reach to give a gift to.' Pawns that count as inside a settlement are skipped, so I couldn't befriend my own people to shape who becomes heir. The HUD doesn't say why, and the members aren't listed anywhere either (the Nations panel shows only '4 members'), so a player can't see or influence the line of succession. tick ~18000

Laws tab: the line under each law describes only the law in force. With Taxes: None and High pending, it still reads 'No tax: members keep their coin.', so a player can't find out what Low or High do (coin rate, loyalty cost, immigration) until 30 s after enacting one. Hover text or a description per option would help. See laws_high.png (also laws2.png for Low). tick 21261

By the end of day 1 the 5-line Chronicle panel scrolls with AI rivalries, stalls and nations falling (~20 nations founded and several disbanded in the first in-game day). My own law changes, like 'Taxes were lifted in Farmfield', go off the panel within seconds. They are highlighted, which helps, but with so much noise statecraft is easy to miss; the status bar shows only one of two laws that took effect on the same tick (15501). tick ~24000
